name: MiTAC Holdings Corporation
summary: MiTAC Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, designs, develops, manufactures, and distributes computers and ancillary equipment, and communication related products in Taiwan, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company offers cloud computing and artificial intelligence products, such as AI Server, HPC server, storage server, cloud computing solution, and open compute project.
